subject: Airship
text: Using the floater near the Ryukahn Desert causes the airship to rise from the sand.

evidence.quote: Port your ship near the river and use your canoe to make it to the mainland(since there are no ports) and then use the floater near the desert. This will prompt the airship to rise from the sand and made available for you to use.

subject: Castle of Ordeals
text: The recommended party level for the Castle of Ordeals is level 24.

evidence.quote:
Castle of Ordeals
Party's level: 24

subject: Castle of Ordeals
text: Taking the bottom warp podium in the Castle of Ordeals leads to a chest containing the Zeus Guantlet.

evidence.quote: The first two warp podiums aren't too hard to manuver past since they are straight forward, after that take the bottom warp podium and collect the Zeus Guantlet and head to the third floor and then go around and pick up the rest of the treasure chests and the Tail.

subject: Castle of Ordeals
text: The Tail can be collected on the third floor of the Castle of Ordeals.

evidence.quote: The first two warp podiums aren't too hard to manuver past since they are straight forward, after that take the bottom warp podium and collect the Zeus Guantlet and head to the third floor and then go around and pick up the rest of the treasure chests and the Tail.

subject: Zombie Dragon
text: The treasure chest near the chair in the Castle of Ordeals is guarded by Zombie Dragons, which can be defeated using Hrm3 and Fire3 spells.

evidence.quote: Watch for the treasure chest near the chair, it's protected by Zombie Dragon(s). Defeat the Dragons by using the Hrm3 spell(if you have it) and Fire3(if you have it) and have the rest of your fighters attack as normal.

subject: Bahamut
text: Speaking with Bahamut in the long hall of Cardia Islands promotes the party's classes.

evidence.quote: Just grab all the items and then speak with Bahamut in the long hall and tell him that you wish to be promoted and he will do so.

subject: Cardia Islands
text: Chests across the six Cardia Islands caves contain Cabin, 575 G, Soft Potion, 10 G, House, 500 G, 160 G, 9500 G, 2750 G, 1520 G, 1455 G, and 2000 G.

evidence.quote:
Items: Cabin, 575 G, Soft Potion, 10 G, House, 500 G, 160 G, 9500 G, 2750 G,
       1520 G, 2750 G, 1455 G, 2000 G...In these islands here there are six entrances to the Cardia Islands.

subject: Caravan
text: The Bottle can be purchased at the Caravan for 50000 G.

evidence.quote: Head up to the Caravan(which is the small desert area seperate from the larger desert next to a small batch of forest) and pruchase the Bottle for 50000 G.

subject: Fairy
text: Opening the bottle frees a fairy, who gives Oxyale when spoken to at the Fairy Spring in the upper right corner of Gaia.

evidence.quote: But eh, check the bottle and it will release a fairy...head straight for the Fairy Spring which is on the upper right most corner of Gaia. Talk to the Fairy and it will give you Oxyale, which is the only way you even stand a chance of surviving in the Sea Shrine.

subject: Sea Shrine
text: Following the long path on the top right in the Sea Shrine leads to the Slab, Opal Helmet, and Opal Guantlet.

evidence.quote: Pick up the items there which include the Slab, Opal Helmet, and Opal Guantlet.

subject: Sea Shrine
text: A Ribbon is located in the top right room along the lower route of the Sea Shrine.

evidence.quote: In here you definitely would want to collect the ribbon(which is located at the top right room of this area) and then head to the top left staircase to the next area which will

subject: Kraken
text: Kraken has 800 HP and is weak to lightning spells such as Lit3.

evidence.quote:
BOSS BATTLE: Kraken       HP: 800
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------...You should use Lit3 constantly if you have it or any lit spell(avoid Lit1 if you have a stronger other elemental spell like Fir2 or Ice2).

subject: Kraken
text: Effective tactics against Kraken include casting Slow on Kraken, casting Fast on fighters, and using Lamp to counter Kraken's Ink.

evidence.quote: Cast Slow on Kraken and cast Fast on your fighters and if Kraken uses Ink, use Lamp(if you have it) to counteract the effects.

subject: The Waterfall
text: Inside the Waterfall, walking to the top left and then down left leads to treasure chests and a robot that provides the Cube.

evidence.quote: Inside here walk around to the top left and then head down left and collect the treasure chests. One of them contains a Cube which you will need to complete your next quest. After you have collected the Cube(which you will need to talk to the robot for) head out of here and go back to your airship.

subject: Dr. Unne
text: Showing the Slab to Dr. Unne in Melmond translates the Lefein language.

evidence.quote: Head back to the town of Melmond(yes, that's right...Melmond) and then talk to Dr. Unne and show him the Slab. He will translate the language for you and then head to the town of Lefein...which is on the Northeast continent.

subject: Lefein
text: Talking to the man in the bottom left part of Lefein grants the Chute needed to enter the Mirage Tower.

evidence.quote: When you head to Lefein, talk to the man in the bottom left part of town, he will give you the Chute needed to get inside the Mirage Tower.

subject: Mirage Tower
text: Using the Cube in the room past the top staircase of the second floor of the Mirage Tower transports the party to the Floating Castle.

evidence.quote: Inside here head up and collect all the treasure chests inside and then head to the next floor, in here head your way towards the top staircase and then use the Cube in the next room to transport you to the Floating Castle.

subject: Floating Castle
text: The bottom left path on the second floor of the Floating Castle contains the Adamant.

evidence.quote: in the next room are 7 different paths. The bottom path is the next destination, but the most important item here is at the bottom left which contains the Adamant.

subject: Floating Castle
text: Looking down through the window in the Floating Castle reveals that the four flowing altars converge into the center of the Temple of Fiends.

evidence.quote: Also if you look down the window you can get a clue as to where to go to next after you have completed this quest...it appears that the four flowing altars all seem to flow into the center of the Temple of Fiends...how odd...

subject: Warmech
text: Moving two columns down and two columns right leads to a long corridor on the fifth floor of the Floating Castle where Warmech can be encountered.

evidence.quote: Now when you first enter the room, move two columns down and then two columns right and you will enter the long corridor(not that hard eh?). Be wary in this corridor though, you may encounter the Warmech and have your long journey come to an end right there and then.

subject: Kraken
text: After the battle step up to the bacl orb and then you will be warped outside.

evidence.quote: After the battle step up to the bacl orb and then you will be warped outside, head to the inn at Onrac and save your game.
